The sentence in that case is intended to apply only to the preceding sections dealing with the book renewal program, as I indicated. I have not the form in front of me but I examined it yesterday with the commission, and as I recollect it the section the right hon. gentleman read has application only to the preceding section dealing with the book renewal program.
